title: The circuit model is authoritative
text: The circuit JSON model is the authority. The visual schematic is an editable view over structured components, pins, wires, junctions, probes, instruments, and metadata. Agent work should inspect and modify the model through host tools rather than reasoning only from pixels.

title: SPICE validates, Frust accelerates
text: The reference path is offline solver simulation through Xyce or another SPICE-class tool. Frust is the extension and acceleration path for math, analysis, realtime previews, and suitable compiled simulation kernels. Do not replace reference validation with compiled preview claims.
